issues.description: Class name mismatch between the problem statement/solution and the template: the exercise specification and the solution repository use a class named 'Meal' (with fields name:String and ingredients:String[] and a corresponding constructor), but the template repository contains an empty src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java and instead provides a concrete class named 'Order' with the same fields and constructor signature as the expected Meal. This inconsistency will confuse students (they will look for a ready-to-use Meal class as described in the problem and UML) and can cause compilation/implementation issues when they follow the specification and tests expecting Meal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the class name consistent across artifacts. Either (A) provide a proper Meal class in the template (implementing the same fields and constructor as in the problem statement) and remove or rename the extraneous Order class, updating all template references (Main, tests) accordingly; or (B) if Order is the intended domain name, update the problem statement, UML and solution to consistently use Order. Prefer option A to match the current problem statement and tests: add src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java with the same implementation as the solution and revise or remove src/de/tum/cit/ase/Order.java.
